newsitem.title: UK: N.Sea April Forties cargoes cut on low Scott output.
newsitem.headline: N.Sea April Forties cargoes cut on low Scott output.

text.p: Two UK North Sea Forties cargoes were cancelled on Thursday because of underperformance at one of the fields contributing into the stream, oil traders said.
Amerada Hess told fellow Forties equity holders that it had cancelled April 14-16 and April 18-20 Forties cargoes because of underperformance at its Scott field, the traders said.
Scott has suffered spasmodic output problems for a lengthy period of time.
Earlier in the week an April 17-19 cargo, not sourced from Scott, was also cancelled.
The three cancellations cut the original April Forties programme by three cargoes to 41, excluding crude piped straight to the Grangemouth refinery.
